CI.trip('exit_cellar').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'mill-cellar', 'into the cellar'); CI.expect(r.kept === false, 'first visit: the cellar is built'); CI.expect(r.lastAside === 'parent' && r.aside.length === 1 && r.aside[0].slot === 'parent' && r.aside[0].level === 'millbrook', 'Millbrook set aside as the parent'); CI.expect(r.weather === 'rain' && r.weatherShown === 'clear' && r.rain === 0 && r.snow === 0 && r.snowCover === 0 && r.overcast < 0.01, 'the room shows no weather; the rain goes on outside'); return JSON.stringify(r); })

(async () => { await CI.sleep(1200); const s = __game.state(); const toast = [...document.querySelectorAll('.lu-toast')].map((t) => t.textContent).join(' | '); CI.expect(s.weather === 'snow' && s.weatherShown === 'clear', 'R in the room: the weather changes outside, none shows inside'); CI.expect(__game.weather.rain.intensity === 0 && __game.weather.snow.intensity === 0 && __game.weather.snowCover === 0 && __game.weather.factor('overcast') < 0.01, 'R in the room: no rain, snow, snow cover or grey sky inside'); CI.expect(/outside/.test(toast), 'R in the room: the toast says the weather is outside'); __game.setWeather('rain'); await CI.sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ weather: s.weather, shown: s.weatherShown, toast, aside: s.campaign.aside }); })()

CI.trip('exit_stairs').then((r) => { CI.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'millbrook', 'back up in Millbrook'); CI.expect(r.kept === true, 'Millbrook attached again, not built (leaving at once)'); CI.expect(r.sameHash === true, 'Millbrook hashes as it did when it was left'); CI.expect(r.lastAside === 'room' && r.aside.length === 1 && r.aside[0].slot === 'room' && r.aside[0].level === 'mill-cellar', 'the cellar kept as the last room'); CI.expect(r.weather === 'rain' && r.weatherShown === 'rain' && r.rain > 0.5, 'the rain outside again'); return JSON.stringify(r); })

(() => { const town = CI.trips.filter((t) => t.level === 'millbrook'); const cellar = CI.trips.filter((t) => t.level === 'mill-cellar'); const one = (a) => new Set(a).size === 1; const key = (t) => JSON.stringify([t.memory, t.scene, t.programsAtArrival]); CI.expect(one(town.map(key)), 'Millbrook: the same GPU memory, scene and programs after every return (no leak): ' + town.map(key).join(' ')); CI.expect(one(cellar.map(key)), 'the cellar: the same GPU memory, scene and programs on every visit: ' + cellar.map(key).join(' ')); CI.expect(CI.trips.every((t) => t.programsAtArrival === t.programsAfterPlay), 'no program compiled after any arrival'); CI.expect(CI.trips.every((t) => t.lights === 12), '12 point lights everywhere'); const kept = CI.trips.filter((t) => t.kept); CI.expect(kept.length === 5 && kept.every((t) => t.buildMs <= 300 && t.travelMs <= 650), 'a level set aside comes back in the fades plus at most 0.3 s: ' + kept.map((t) => t.travelMs + '/' + t.buildMs).join(' ')); CI.expect(kept.every((t) => t.prepBefore === null && t.prepUsed === null), 'nothing built ahead toward a level set aside: ' + kept.map((t) => t.prepBefore).join(' ')); CI.expect(town.every((t) => t.npcs.present >= t.npcs.all - 1 && t.npcs.animated >= 1), 'villagers there and animated on every return'); CI.expect(town.reduce((n, t) => n + t.npcs.moved, 0) >= 1, 'villagers walk on after a return'); return JSON.stringify(CI.summary()); })()

(async () => { const c = __game.game.campaign; CI.expect(c.levelId === 'millbrook' && c._aside.room?.id === 'mill-cellar', 'in Millbrook, the cellar set aside'); const t = CI.trips.at(-1); await CI.trip('exit_cellar'); const k = c._aside.parent?.kept; CI.expect(!!k, 'in the cellar, Millbrook set aside'); k.world.attach = () => { throw new Error('test: attaching the town fails'); }; const ok = await __game.campaign.exit('exit_stairs'); await CI.sleep(1200); const s = __game.state(); CI.expect(!ok && s.campaign.level === 'mill-cellar' && __game.game.mode === 'play', 'a level set aside that fails to attach: back in the room, built again'); CI.expect(s.campaign.aside.length === 0, 'after the failed attach nothing is set aside (the town and the room left released)'); const sc = CI.sceneSize(); const cellar = CI.trips.filter((x) => x.level === 'mill-cellar').at(-1); CI.expect(sc.objects === cellar.scene.objects && sc.children === cellar.scene.children, 'no ghost copy in the scene after the failed attach: ' + JSON.stringify([sc, cellar.scene])); const r = await CI.trip('exit_stairs'); CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === false && r.level === 'millbrook', 'the town built again after the failure'); CI.expect(JSON.stringify(r.scene) === JSON.stringify(t.scene) && r.memory.geometries <= t.memory.geometries && r.memory.textures <= t.memory.textures, 'after the failed attach: the same scene and no more GPU memory than before (no leak): ' + JSON.stringify([r.memory, r.scene, t.memory, t.scene])); const r2 = await CI.trip('exit_cellar'); const r3 = await CI.trip('exit_stairs'); CI.expect(r2.kept && r3.kept && JSON.stringify([r3.memory, r3.scene]) === JSON.stringify([r.memory, r.scene]), 'after the failure the round trips are steady again: ' + JSON.stringify([r.memory, r3.memory])); return JSON.stringify({ ok, level: s.campaign.level, aside: s.campaign.aside, scene: sc, after: [r.memory, r3.memory] }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const c = g.campaign; c.dropAside(); await CI.sleep(500); const alone = { memory: CI.gpu(), scene: CI.sceneSize() }; const orig = g._buildLevel; g._buildLevel = async (...a) => { g._buildLevel = orig; await orig(...a); throw new Error('test: building the cellar fails'); }; const ok = await __game.campaign.exit('exit_cellar'); await CI.sleep(1200); const s = __game.state(); CI.expect(!ok && s.campaign.level === 'millbrook' && g.mode === 'play', 'a build that fails with the town set aside: back in the town, built again'); CI.expect(s.campaign.aside.length === 0, 'after the failed build nothing is set aside'); const after = { memory: CI.gpu(), scene: CI.sceneSize() }; CI.expect(JSON.stringify(after.scene) === JSON.stringify(alone.scene) && after.memory.geometries <= alone.memory.geometries && after.memory.textures <= alone.memory.textures, 'after the failed build: the scene of the town alone and no more GPU memory (no leak): ' + JSON.stringify([after, alone])); const r = await CI.trip('exit_cellar'); CI.expect(r.ok && r.kept === false && r.aside.length === 1, 'into the cellar after the failure'); const r2 = await CI.trip('exit_stairs'); CI.expect(r2.ok && r2.kept === true && r2.sameHash === true, 'and back, the town attached again'); return JSON.stringify({ ok, level: s.campaign.level, alone, after, aside: r2.aside }); })()

(async () => { const c = __game.game.campaign; c.prepareAhead = false; const shared = new Set(__game.game.textures._materials.values()); const res = new Set(); for (const e of Object.values(c._aside)) if (e) { e.kept.world.root.traverse((o) => { if (o.geometry) res.add(o.geometry); const m = o.material; for (const x of Array.isArray(m) ? m : m ? [m] : []) if (!shared.has(x)) res.add(x); }); for (const s of __game.game._actorSprites(e.kept)) { res.add(s.material); res.add(s.mesh.geometry); } } const gone = new Set(); for (const x of res) x.addEventListener('dispose', () => gone.add(x)); const r = await CI.trip('exit_east', { at: [36, 16.5] }); CI.expect(r.ok && r.level === 'mill-road' && r.kept === false, 'to mill-road (built)'); CI.expect(r.aside.length === 0 && r.dropped >= 1, 'to a level that is neither a room nor set aside: everything set aside dropped'); CI.expect(res.size > 0 && gone.size === res.size, 'the dropped level released: every geometry and material of its world and actors disposed, the shared materials of the texture library aside (' + gone.size + '/' + res.size + ')'); CI.road = r; return JSON.stringify({ resources: res.size, disposed: gone.size, ...r }); })()

(async () => { const r1 = await CI.trip('exit_west', { at: [3, 8.5] }); const r2 = await CI.trip('exit_cellar'); CI.expect(r1.ok && r2.ok && r2.level === 'mill-cellar' && r2.aside.length === 1 && r2.aside[0].level === 'millbrook', 'back to Millbrook and into the cellar, Millbrook set aside'); __game.campaign.setFlag('lantern-found'); await CI.sleep(500); const r3 = await CI.trip('exit_stairs'); const s = __game.state(); CI.expect(r3.ok && r3.level === 'millbrook' && r3.kept === false && s.campaign.file === 'millbrook-dusk', 'a chapter that swaps the file while the town is set aside: the town built from its variant, not attached'); CI.expect(r3.aside.length === 1 && r3.aside[0].level === 'mill-cellar', 'the cellar kept as the last room'); CI.expect(r3.programsAtArrival === r3.programsAfterPlay, 'no program compiled after arriving in the variant'); return JSON.stringify({ file: s.campaign.file, kept: r3.kept, dropped: r3.dropped, aside: r3.aside, travelMs: r3.travelMs }); })()
